responsibility: Tests the layout tree pruning behavior, especially how definition nodes with and without safety invariants are removed, preserved as unit layout, or cause uninhabited results when they make a branch invisible.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `maybe_transmutable/tests.rs`, these tests stay local to the `layout::tree` layer and focus narrowly on `Tree::prune` semantics for definition nodes becoming removed, unit, or uninhabited. They do not exercise end-to-end `MaybeTransmutableQuery` answers or assumption handling.
